title: Select mounts after a Stantler mount and dismount cycle

verification.actor: Saved Stantler Follower in party slot 0, then chosen Mankey in slot 2 as Follower and Mounted
verification.trigger: Press Select to mount saved Stantler, release it, press Select again to dismount, then use Y/R/Y to choose Mankey and press Select once while the follower-change queue is active
verification.observable: Stantler mounts and returns to Follower as the same actor. The final native Select edge is retained through the queued follower change; the same newly created Mankey mounts within 120 completed game frames without another Select press
limits: The unchanged test.sav supplies Stantler and Mankey. No party, follower, profile, map or timer state is prepared.
This is one normal Stantler mount/dismount cycle, one follower switch, and one final Select edge. It does not prove long-run input reliability or mounted movement.
The 120-frame limit counts completed main-task-queue updates, not video cycles or host time.

events.value: Read the unchanged saved Stantler follower
Press and release Select to mount Stantler, then press and release Select to dismount it
Y opens the selector, R highlights slot 2 Mankey, and Y confirms the follower change
After one release frame, press Select once while the follower-change queue is active
Wait up to 120 completed frames with no further Select input for the chosen Mankey to mount

stop.condition: Stantler mounts and dismounts, then Mankey mounts within 120 completed frames of the final Select edge, or the first invalid observation

invariants: Each accepted motion has exactly one terminal result
No logical commit occurs after motion cancellation
Control returns after the selected motion finishes or cancels
No active actors share a nonzero target reservation
Every active actor handle uses the current field epoch
Every active actor has an attached presentation
